notes: m21-fidelity (engine fixer's finding, 2026-10-29). Printed: '[-2]: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures attack this turn, create that many 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.' The ability creates a DELAYED triggered ability (CR 603.7): it lives for the turn on its own, so it still works after Basri Ket is gone. Activated at 2 loyalty, Basri goes to 0 and dies (CR 704.5i); attacking with two creatures still makes 2 attacking Soldiers: 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 9, seat 1 at 11. Before the fix the -2 granted the trigger to Basri himself until end of turn, so with Basri dead no Soldiers came.
